title: Quintessential Peruvian Mushroom Rocoto Relleno
description: A pungent and flavorful Peruvian dish featuring mushrooms and rocoto peppers, perfect for a hangover cure or a plant-based meal option. This recipe is a unique twist on traditional rocoto relleno, with a bouncy texture from the mushrooms.
instructions: Roast the rocoto peppers in the oven at 400 degrees for 30 minutes, then peel and seed them.
Saute the chopped onion and minced garlic in olive oil until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the onion mixture and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Stuff each roasted rocoto pepper with the mushroom mixture and top with salt and black pepper.
Serve the rocoto relleno warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the dish cool completely before refrigerating or freezing.
Reheat the rocoto relleno in the oven or microwave until warmed through.
